message.content: {"question":"Let S be a linear system of 4 equations and 3 variables, and let M=(A|B) be the complete matrix associated to S if det(M)≠0, which one of the following statements is certainly true","options":{"A":"S admits infinite solutions","B":"S does not have any solutions","C":"S admits only one solution","D":"the zero vector is a solution of S"},"correct":"C"}
